title: The Girls of Penthouse No. 8 Collector's Edition Corinne Alphen Pet of the Year
condition_description: Complete. Front cover has scattered white specks/scuffs, mostly on the left side (see photos). Back cover clean. Spine intact.
description:
The Girls of Penthouse No. 8 - Collector's Edition, Pet of the Year Special. Celebrates Corinne Alphen, 1982-83 Pet of the Year, and the Pet of the Year phenomenon since the early seventies. More than 190 color pictures. Cover photograph of Corinne Alphen by Bob Guccione. Original $3.95 cover price.

Back cover: black text page about the Pet of the Year.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
